_comment: Per-guest corrections to what Criterion's collection page lists. Criterion.com is the sole primary source for picks, so an entry here is a deliberate decision to contradict it, and needs evidence from the video itself. Keyed by guest_slug; each entry replaces the pick at from_criterion_url with the film at to_criterion_url. Applied by scrape_criterion_picks.py after every scrape, so the correction survives a re-scrape.

slavoj-zizek.note: Criterion's page lists Stranger Than Paradise at slot 6, but the video has The Ice Storm there. At 1:17 Zizek says 'I have a perfect personal attachment to this film. When James Schamus was writing the scenario he told me that he was reading a book of mine.' Schamus wrote The Ice Storm; Jarmusch wrote Stranger Than Paradise himself in 1984. The transcript never says 'Stranger', 'Paradise' (outside Trouble in Paradise at 0:00) or 'Jarmusch', and all 12 slots align 1:1 between video and page except this one.
